summary: TikTok and Amplify have joined forces to announce The Next Episode, a new content initiative designed to help brands move beyond traditional short-form content and invest in creator-led series. As demand for longer-form, episodic entertainment continues to grow, the new initiative connects brands with Amplify's creator network to develop and produce original, social-first series, with eligible brands able to access production support through TikTok alongside their media investment.
title: TikTok and Amplify launch new creator-led content series for brands
